entries.title: Mark 4:2
segments: Many things in parables. See notes on

entries.title: Mark 4:11
segments: The mystery of the kingdom of God. See note on

entries.title: Mark 4:12
segments: That seeing they may see. 'Seeing they see not.'  See note on

entries.title: Mark 4:13
segments: Know ye not this parable? As if it were not easily understood without on interpretation.

entries.title: Mark 4:14
segments: The sower soweth the word. Christ, the sower of the seed of divine truth.

entries.title: Mark 4:15
segments: The way side. The hard, trodden road.

entries.title: Mark 4:24
segments: With what measure ye mete. Ye shall increase in spiritual knowledge according to your attentiveness and diligence.

entries.title: Mark 4:25
segments: He that hath not. See note on

entries.title: Mark 4:26
segments: As if a man should cast seed upon the earth. Mark is the only one of the evangelists who records this parable.  'A man' here means Christ, and 'the earth' is the spiritual nature and needs of man.

entries.title: Mark 4:27
segments: He knoweth not how. He does not understand the unseen power by which the seed grows, and which is constantly taking effect.

entries.title: Mark 4:28
segments: First the blade. The gradual unfolding of the plant counsels patience in the development of character.

entries.title: Mark 4:31
segments: Like a grain of mustard seed. See note on

entries.title: Mark 4:35
segments: The other side. The east side of the Sea of Galilee.

entries.title: Mark 4:38
segments: Carest thou not that we perish? See note on
